# MAVLink libevents parser

This directory contains the unchanged Python event metadata parser from
[MAVLink libevents at 840a88ea](https://github.com/mavlink/libevents/tree/840a88ea226d4eb0fd4c391ce860317422756435/libs/python/libevents_parse).
MAVSDK 4.0.5 pins the same revision. The accompanying license applies to
the parser source.
